items.title: Rick Margitza interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, November 22, 2024
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] You and Alan Broadbent. He is a Mahler aficionado I would say. [INTERVIEWEE] Oh really. Wow.

ctx.x: It really is. Two minutes worth of music — I was reading an article, an interview of Vince Mendoza and he was talking about two or three minutes of music and how much that actually is, without any improvising. That’s a lot of music to compose to fit — yeah ‘cause we’re so used to just having something, you know just a little blues head and then the solos could take up most of the space. But yeah, it’s a challenge obviously. And I’m a huge fan of Mahler. So his time scale is huge. You know half an hour movements…
You and Alan Broadbent. He is a Mahler aficionado I would say.
Oh really. Wow. © Fillius Jazz Archive -5-
